title: Deep Learning the EEG Manifold for Phonological Categorization from Active Thoughts
answer_short: By computing the channel cross-covariance, resulting in positive, semi-definite matrices encoding the connectivity of the electrodes.
answer_rationale: The spatial aspect of the EEG signal was computed by calculating the channel cross-covariance between electrodes, which generates positive, semi-definite matrices that encode electrode connectivity. This approach was chosen to capture information transfer among electrodes, as opposed to using raw multi-channel EEG data, and was found to contain more discriminative features than raw signals.
